name: Weibo video

disclosure.zh: 含 AI 生成内容时，在「选择内容声明」里选「内容由 AI 生成」。投稿标题至少 6 个字；话题写成 #话题#（两个 #）。个人网站链接常会被提示风险或拦截。
disclosure.en: If the video has AI content, choose 选择内容声明 → 内容由 AI 生成. 投稿 titles need at least 6 characters; topics are #话题# (two hashes). Links to personal sites often get a risk prompt or are blocked.

guide.zh: 打开视频投稿页，应用放入视频、填好标题、简介和 #话题#。频道分类、标签、原创 / 转载、合集由你选，再点「发布」。
guide.en: On the video 投稿 page the app adds the video and types the title, intro and #topics#. Pick the channel category, tags, original / repost and collection, then press Publish yourself.

zh: 内容声明（含 AI 生成）

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written 2026-10 without a logged-in session): check them on the live page, then set status to verified + lastVerified.
PC upload up to 15 GB (kefu FAQ). Posting from the home composer also works but has no title field.
